lines.text: Ban ja ni aj meri queen tu,haye
Ki dasaa how much haseen tu,aah
Main hoon tera,tu hain meri baat fix hai
Hath mein tere yeh mera hath fix hai
Aankh na mila tu chahe meri ankh se
Khwab mein hi tere mere khwab fix ha
Oh yeah,akhiyan ne wekhe meri tere hi ta dream ni
Tenu mai paton layee landa firan scheam ni
Tuhi lagge soni tenu maari jawa line mai
Tu je puchhe haal mera hoyee janwa fine mai
Ishq gudh nallo mitha karla tu taste ni
Single single teri jawani hoee jandi waste ni
Maihan tera ranjha baby kyon ni kardi understand
Tuje mainu yes kare ta laike aavan wedding band
